text: This report recommends approval of two grants with a combined value of $354,750.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the following grants to be funded from the endowments indicated: a. $144,750 over 18 months (from the Toronto, Ontario, and Canada endowments) to Affine Climate Solutions Society to accelerate the widespread adoption of low carbon, climate-resilient construction by transforming how financial institutions (FIs) assess, value, and finance green buildings. The funding recommendation is subject to the following condition: i. At least 20 percent of the buildings proposed for the financing pilot are to be located in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA). b. $210,000 over 24 months (from the Toronto and Canada endowments) to Efficiency Canada to make the case at all three levels of government for improving appliance and equipment efficiency, ensuring the capacity of existing/new technologies to provide flexibility to…
